title: The Offer from Abroad
notebook: Jonas has a job offer: lead architect for a Lytheirian firm's public housing division. Triple his salary.
The job is in Lytheira. He would have to leave Veltria. He has been weighing it for three weeks.
Jonas: 'If I stay, I stay for you. I need to know whether that is enough.'

narrative.text: Jonas places a letter on the kitchen table. A prestigious Lytheirian architecture firm — one of the most respected in the world — has offered him a position. Lead architect on their public housing division. The salary is triple what he has ever earned. The position is in Lytheira. He would have to leave Veltria.

I have been thinking about this for three weeks. I did not tell you because I did not want you to influence my decision before I made it. This is not about us. It is about me. For twenty years I have been an architect in a country that does not value architecture. I have designed public housing that was never built, urban plans that were shelved, proposals that were rejected because the money went to weapons instead. This firm — they build things. They have built housing for two hundred thousand people. If I go, I will finally do the work I was trained to do. If I stay, I stay for you. And I need to know whether that is enough.

choices.text: "Go. You have spent twenty years building my career. You have been the husband of a Chancellor when you never asked to be. You have been a political figure when all you wanted to be was an architect. This is your chance to do what you love, at the highest level, for people who need it. I will not ask you to stay. I love you too much to ask you to stay."

"I cannot ask you to stay for me. But I can ask you to stay for Veltria. You said it yourself — we need architects who care about public housing. You have spent twenty years fighting to build things here. If you leave now, who fights that fight? I am not asking you to stay for our marriage. I am asking you to stay for the country you have been trying to help since the day I met you."
